explication: Another Redis Desktop Manager is a cross-platform GUI for managing Redis-compatible databases. Users configure or select a connection, connect to a server, browse keys, open a key to inspect or edit its type-specific contents, and run commands through the CLI. The interface also exposes operational views and utilities such as slow logs, memory analysis, command history, custom formatters, and binary decoders. The sampled code confirms the app shell, Redis client behavior, vector commands, and protobuf persistence; several other feature links are omitted where their wiring was not shown.
